name: Monotheism
overview: The Scriptures affirm the foundational truth of monotheism, declaring that the LORD alone is God, with no other gods beside Him (Deuteronomy 4:35, 4:39). From the creation of the heavens and the earth by God alone (Genesis 1:1) to the command that no other gods be worshiped before Him (Exodus 20:3), the Bible emphasizes the exclusive sovereignty of the one true God. This unity is further underscored in the confession of Israel that the LORD our God is one LORD (Deuteronomy 6:4), highlighting the singular divine nature who created humanity in His image (Genesis 1:26).
